name: Music Instrument Store
place: A music store with guitars and pianos
role: You are a musician sales clerk.
speaker: Clerk

tasks.goal: Greet the music store clerk and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the music store clerk and stated purpose.

Japanese.goal: 楽器店の店員にあいさつして用件を伝える
Japanese.hint: 着いたら、まず用件をはっきり伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about beginner acoustic guitar models and price range
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to show entry-level acoustic guitars.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about acoustic guitar models and prices.

Japanese.goal: 初心者向けのアコースティックギターの機種と価格帯について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 入門用のアコースティックギターを見せてほしいと店員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if acoustic guitar body is solid wood or laminate
tasks.hint: Inquire about guitar wood materials.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about guitar body construction materials.

Japanese.goal: アコースティックギターのボディが単板か合板か尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ギターの木材について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request permission to test play an electric guitar in soundproof room
tasks.hint: Ask to try out an instrument before buying.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to test play guitar in soundproof booth.
tasks.scene_hint: Distorted guitar riffs and gentle piano chords resonate across instrument displays.

Japanese.goal: 防音室でエレキギターを試奏させてもらえるか頼む
Japanese.hint: 買う前に楽器を試してみたいと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about guitar amplifier wattage and headphone jack inputs
tasks.hint: Inquire about practice amp features.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about guitar amplifier specs.

Japanese.goal: ギターアンプのワット数とヘッドホン端子について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 練習用アンプの機能について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'metronome'
tasks.hint: Metronome is a device that marks exact musical tempo. Ask if electronic metronomes are in stock.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'metronome'.

Japanese.goal: 「メトロノーム」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: メトロノームとは、正確なテンポを刻む道具です。電子メトロノームの在庫があるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if store offers guitar tuning and string replacement services
tasks.hint: Ask about maintenance services.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tuning and string replacement services.

Japanese.goal: ギターのチューニングや弦交換のサービスがあるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: メンテナンスのサービスについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate including a padded gig bag case with guitar purchase
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to bundle a protective case.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated adding gig bag case with purchase.

Japanese.goal: ギターの購入にクッション入りのギグバッグを付けてもらうよう交渉する
Japanese.hint: 保護用のケースをセットにしてほしいと店員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about introductory guitar lesson packages for beginners
tasks.hint: Inquire if music lessons are taught on site.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about music lesson availability.

Japanese.goal: 初心者向けのギター入門レッスンのセットについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 店内で音楽レッスンをしているか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Address issue where guitar action string height is too high
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to adjust neck truss rod for easier playing.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for guitar neck action adjustment.
tasks.scene_hint: Rows of polished guitars hang from wall mounts above brass drum cymbals.

Japanese.goal: ギターの弦高が高すぎる問題に対応する
Japanese.hint: 弾きやすくなるようにネックのトラスロッドを調整してほしいと店員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if sheet music books for popular songs are in stock
tasks.hint: Inquire about sheet music selections.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sheet music book availability.

Japanese.goal: 人気曲の楽譜集の在庫があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 楽譜の品ぞろえについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm instrument return policy and trial period length
tasks.hint: Verify terms for returning an instrument.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed instrument return policy terms.

Japanese.goal: 楽器の返品条件とお試し期間の長さを確認する
Japanese.hint: 楽器を返品するときの条件を確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request printed sales receipt showing serial number and warranty
tasks.hint: Ask for official receipt with instrument serial number.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested receipt with instrument serial number.

Japanese.goal: 製造番号と保証が記載された印刷レシートをお願いする
Japanese.hint: 楽器の製造番号が載った正式なレシートがほしいと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask where guitar picks and clip-on electronic tuners are displayed
tasks.hint: Inquire about small accessories at checkout.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about guitar accessories at checkout.

Japanese.goal: ギターのピックとクリップ式チューナーが置いてある場所を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: レジ近くの小物について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the music store clerk and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the music store clerk AND said goodbye.

Japanese.goal: 楽器店の店員にお礼を言って別れのあいさつをする
Japanese.hint: 感謝の気持ちを伝えて会話を終えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about student violin rental packages
tasks.hint: Ask about monthly rental rates and included bow case.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about student violin rental options.
tasks.scene_hint: A wooden pegboard holds small student violins alongside rows of padded black carrying cases.

Japanese.goal: 学生向けのバイオリンのレンタルセットについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 月々のレンタル料と、弓やケースが含まれるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for assistance choosing digital piano with weighted keys
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to recommend weighted key keyboards.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help selecting a digital piano with weighted keys.
tasks.scene_hint: A customer taps a key on a digital piano as soft synth tones echo from speaker monitors.

Japanese.goal: 鍵盤に重みのある電子ピアノ選びを手伝ってもらう
Japanese.hint: 重い鍵盤のキーボードのおすすめを店員に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if store buys used vintage instruments
tasks.hint: Ask if trade-ins or used instrument purchases are accepted.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about used instrument trade-in policies.
tasks.scene_hint: A scuffed leather guitar case sits open on the bench showing a weathered vintage electric bass.

Japanese.goal: 古いビンテージ楽器を買い取ってもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 下取りや中古楽器の買い取りをしているか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Verify warranty registration process for new synthesizer
tasks.hint: Ask how to register manufacturer warranty online.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified warranty registration process for synthesizer.
tasks.scene_hint: A boxed digital synthesizer sits on the counter beside a pamphlet printed with warranty registration terms.

Japanese.goal: 新しいシンセサイザーの保証登録の手続きを確認する
Japanese.hint: メーカー保証をオンラインで登録する方法を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about layaway payment options for high-end saxophone
tasks.hint: Inquire if deposit holds instrument over several months.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about layaway payment options.
tasks.scene_hint: A polished brass tenor saxophone hangs under a spotlight with a price tag indicating layaway available.

Japanese.goal: 高級サックスの取り置き分割払いについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 頭金を払えば数か月楽器を取り置いてもらえるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm store weekend business hours for gear pickup
tasks.hint: Ask clerk what time store opens on Saturdays.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed store weekend business hours.
tasks.scene_hint: A heavy store schedule placard hangs near the front glass entrance above rows of speaker stands.

Japanese.goal: 機材を受け取るため、週末の営業時間を確認する
Japanese.hint: 土曜日は何時に開店するか店員に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about electronic invoice copy sent via email
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to send digital copy of sales invoice.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested electronic copy of invoice.
tasks.scene_hint: The register monitor flickers while a clerk enters an email address onto a digital receipt form.

Japanese.goal: 電子請求書の控えをメールで送ってもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 請求書のデータを送ってほしいと店員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask where instrument care kits and cleaning cloths are stocked
tasks.hint: Inquire about maintenance accessories at register.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about care kits and polish cloths at checkout.
tasks.scene_hint: Yellow micro-fiber polishing cloths and bottles of fretboard oil line a display rack by the counter.

Japanese.goal: 楽器のお手入れセットとクロスが置いてある場所を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: レジにあるメンテナンス用品について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm parking validation at checkout register
tasks.hint: Ask if parking garage ticket can be validated with purchase.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed parking validation at checkout.
tasks.scene_hint: A small parking garage stamp tool sits beside the touch screen checkout register.

Japanese.goal: レジで駐車券の割引処理をしてもらえるか確認する
Japanese.hint: 買い物をすれば駐車場の料金が割引になるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'craftsmanship'
tasks.hint: Craftsmanship refers to the quality of design and work shown in something made by hand. Praise the high craftsmanship of the wooden acoustic guitar.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'craftsmanship'.

Japanese.goal: 「職人技」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 職人技とは、手作りの物に表れる設計や仕事の質の高さのことです。木製のアコースティックギターの見事な職人技をほめましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'acoustics'
tasks.hint: Acoustics refers to the properties of a venue or instrument that determine sound quality. Inquire about the natural acoustics of the hollow body.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'acoustics'.

Japanese.goal: 「響き」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 響きとは、会場や楽器の音の質を決める性質のことです。空洞ボディの自然な響きについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'attachment'
tasks.hint: An attachment is an accessory connected to equipment to add functionality. Ask if the store includes a quick-release neck attachment.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'attachment'.

Japanese.goal: 「アタッチメント」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: アタッチメントとは、機材に取り付けて機能を増やす付属品のことです。ネックにワンタッチで付け外しできるアタッチメントが付いているか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'restoration'
tasks.hint: Restoration is the work of repairing and renewing an item to its original state. Inquire about the instrument restoration service.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'restoration'.

Japanese.goal: 「修復」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 修復とは、物を直して元の状態に戻す作業のことです。楽器の修復サービスについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about trumpet mouthpiece sizes for jazz playing
tasks.hint: Ask clerk which mouthpiece size suits jazz sound.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about trumpet mouthpiece sizes for jazz.
tasks.scene_hint: A velvet-lined tray on the counter holds silver-plated trumpet mouthpieces of various cup sizes.

Japanese.goal: ジャズ演奏に合うトランペットのマウスピースのサイズについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ジャズの音に合うマウスピースのサイズを店員に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if store carries replacement drumheads and tuning keys
tasks.hint: Inquire about drum hardware and replacement heads.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about replacement drumheads and tuning keys.
tasks.scene_hint: Mylar drumheads of various diameters lean against a glass shelf holding metal drum tuning keys.

Japanese.goal: 交換用のドラムヘッドとチューニングキーを扱っているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ドラムの金具や交換用ヘッドについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request demonstration of analog synthesizer patch cables
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to show patch cable routing options.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested demonstration of analog synthesizer patch cables.

Japanese.goal: アナログシンセサイザーのパッチケーブルの実演をお願いする
Japanese.hint: パッチケーブルのつなぎ方をいくつか見せてほしいと店員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about noise-canceling headphones compatible with digital piano
tasks.hint: Ask for headphone recommendations for quiet practice.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about headphones for digital piano.

Japanese.goal: 電子ピアノに使えるノイズキャンセリングヘッドホンについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 静かに練習するためのヘッドホンのおすすめを聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Address issue where trumpet valve sticks during play
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to inspect sticky valve and apply valve oil.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported sticky trumpet valve and requested assistance.

Japanese.goal: 演奏中にトランペットのピストンが引っかかる問題に対応する
Japanese.hint: 引っかかるピストンを点検してバルブオイルをさしてほしいと店員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about audio interface USB setup for home recording studio
tasks.hint: Inquire about recording audio interface inputs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about audio interface USB setup for recording.

Japanese.goal: 宅録スタジオ用のオーディオインターフェースのUSB接続の設定について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 録音用オーディオインターフェースの入力端子について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request trial of different bass guitar strap padding materials
tasks.hint: Ask to try leather versus neoprene straps for comfort.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to test different bass guitar strap padding.

Japanese.goal: ベースのストラップのクッション素材を比べて試させてもらう
Japanese.hint: 付け心地を比べるため、革とネオプレンのストラップを試したいと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if store offers amp repair and tube replacement service
tasks.hint: Ask about amplifier repair turnaround time.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about amplifier repair and tube replacement services.

Japanese.goal: アンプの修理と真空管の交換サービスがあるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: アンプの修理にどのくらい時間がかかるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about ukulele sizes between soprano, concert, and tenor
tasks.hint: Inquire about tonal differences between ukulele sizes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ukulele size differences.

Japanese.goal: ソプラノ、コンサート、テナーのウクレレのサイズの違いについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ウクレレのサイズによる音色の違いを聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request assistance selecting acoustic foam panels for soundproofing
tasks.hint: Ask how many foam panels are needed for room.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help choosing acoustic foam panels.

Japanese.goal: 防音用の吸音材パネル選びを手伝ってもらう
Japanese.hint: 部屋に吸音パネルが何枚必要か聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about microphone stand heavy base stability
tasks.hint: Ask if stand base prevents tipping during live performance.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about microphone stand base stability.

Japanese.goal: マイクスタンドの重いベースの安定性について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ライブ中にスタンドが倒れないか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report crack in violin bow horsehair bundle
tasks.hint: Point out loose or damaged bow hair before rental.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported cracked or damaged violin bow hair.

Japanese.goal: バイオリンの弓の毛の束が傷んでいることを伝える
Japanese.hint: レンタルする前に、弓の毛がゆるんでいたり傷んでいたりすることを指摘しましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about MIDI controller keyboard compatibility with iPad
tasks.hint: Inquire if keyboard connects directly via lightning port.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about MIDI controller iPad compatibility.

Japanese.goal: ミディ（電子楽器の接続規格）キーボードがアイパッドに対応しているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: キーボードをライトニング端子に直接つなげるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request clerk adjust shoulder rest on rental violin
tasks.hint: Ask for custom fit adjustment on violin shoulder rest.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested shoulder rest adjustment on violin.

Japanese.goal: レンタルのバイオリンの肩当てを調整してもらうよう店員に頼む
Japanese.hint: 肩当てを自分の体に合わせて調整してほしいと頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about accordion treble and bass button layout
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to explain button layout on accordion.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about accordion button layout.

Japanese.goal: アコーディオンの右手と左手のボタン配置について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: アコーディオンのボタン配置を店員に説明してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if store hosts masterclasses with guest guitarists
tasks.hint: Inquire about schedule of workshops and clinics.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about store guitar masterclasses and workshops.

Japanese.goal: ゲストのギタリストによる公開レッスンを開いているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ワークショップやセミナーの予定について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report buzzing sound on low E string of classical guitar
tasks.hint: Inform clerk that string rattles against fret wire.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported string buzz on classical guitar.

Japanese.goal: クラシックギターの6弦（低いミの弦）でビビり音がすることを伝える
Japanese.hint: 弦がフレットに当たってビリビリ鳴ることを店員に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about wireless guitar transmitter system range
tasks.hint: Ask how far wireless transmitter signal reaches stage.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about wireless guitar system range.

Japanese.goal: ギター用ワイヤレス送信機の届く距離について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ワイヤレス送信機の電波がステージのどこまで届くか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if sheet music stand folds compactly for travel
tasks.hint: Inquire about portable folding music stand features.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if sheet music stand is portable for travel.

Japanese.goal: 譜面台が持ち運び用にコンパクトに折りたためるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 持ち運べる折りたたみ譜面台の特徴について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request clerk demonstrate slap bass technique on active pickup bass
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to demo active electronics tone controls.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested demonstration of slap bass technique.

Japanese.goal: アクティブピックアップのベースでスラップ奏法を実演してもらう
Japanese.hint: アクティブ回路の音色の調整を実演してほしいと店員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about flute sterling silver headjoint upgrade
tasks.hint: Ask how silver headjoint changes tone quality.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sterling silver flute headjoint upgrade.

Japanese.goal: フルートの頭部管をスターリングシルバー（純銀）製にアップグレードすることについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 銀の頭部管にすると音色がどう変わるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about volume pedal sweep resistance adjustment
tasks.hint: Inquire if volume pedal tension can be tightened.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about volume pedal tension adjustment.

Japanese.goal: ボリュームペダルの踏み込みの重さの調整について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ボリュームペダルを固めに調整できるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report missing power supply adapter for effect pedal
tasks.hint: Inform clerk that pedal box lacks power cable.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing power supply adapter for effect pedal.

Japanese.goal: エフェクターの電源アダプターが入っていないことを伝える
Japanese.hint: ペダルの箱に電源ケーブルが入っていないことを店員に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about cello endpin stopper floor protection pads
tasks.hint: Ask about rubber endpin anchors for hardwood floors.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cello endpin floor anchors.

Japanese.goal: 床を守るチェロのエンドピンストッパーについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: フローリング用のゴム製エンドピンストッパーについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if store offers band instrument rental insurance
tasks.hint: Inquire about loss and theft protection plans for instruments.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about band instrument rental insurance.

Japanese.goal: 吹奏楽器のレンタル保険があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 楽器の紛失や盗難の補償プランについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request clerk check neck curvature with straightedge
tasks.hint: Ask technician to verify guitar neck relief line.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested clerk check guitar neck curvature.

Japanese.goal: 定規でネックの反りを確認してもらうよう店員に頼む
Japanese.hint: ギターのネックの反り具合を確認してほしいとリペアスタッフに頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about percussion mallet hardness levels for marimba
tasks.hint: Ask which mallets yield soft vs bright marimba tone.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about percussion mallet hardness options.

Japanese.goal: マリンバ用マレットの硬さの種類について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 柔らかい音と明るい音が出るマレットをそれぞれ聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if studio monitor speakers include balanced XLR cables
tasks.hint: Inquire about cables included in studio monitor box.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about studio monitor cabling inclusions.

Japanese.goal: モニタースピーカーにバランス型のキャノンケーブルが付いているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: モニタースピーカーの箱にどのケーブルが入っているか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report loose tuning machine peg on 12-string guitar
tasks.hint: Inform technician of loose tuner gear screw.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported loose tuning machine peg on guitar.

Japanese.goal: 12弦ギターの糸巻き（ペグ）がゆるんでいることを伝える
Japanese.hint: 糸巻きのギアのネジがゆるんでいることをリペアスタッフに伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about clarinet reed strength ratings from 2 to 3.5
tasks.hint: Ask which reed strength is recommended for beginners.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about clarinet reed strength ratings.

Japanese.goal: クラリネットのリードの硬さ（2から3.5）について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 初心者にはどの硬さのリードがおすすめか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if store sells replacement potentiometer knobs for electric guitars
tasks.hint: Inquire about plastic and metal guitar control knobs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about replacement potentiometer knobs.

Japanese.goal: エレキギター用の交換用ポットのつまみを売っているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: プラスチック製と金属製のギターのつまみについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request clerk demonstrate wah-wah pedal expression filter
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to play guitar through wah pedal.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested wah-wah pedal demonstration.

Japanese.goal: ワウペダルの音の効果を実演してもらうよう店員に頼む
Japanese.hint: ワウペダルを通してギターを弾いてほしいと店員に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about harmonica key availability in C major and G major
tasks.hint: Ask which harmonica keys are best for blues playing.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about harmonica key availability.

Japanese.goal: ハ長調とト長調のハーモニカがあるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ブルースを吹くにはどの調のハーモニカがいいか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if electric drum kit includes bass drum kick pedal
tasks.hint: Inquire about kick tower and pedal inclusion in electronic kit.
